original_context_note: Compared spec.full_target literally with target-selection.json/full_target, and mathematically with problem.md:16–41 and the duplicate retained basis-evidence-000.txt. H001–H006 preserve the prime, arbitrary field of characteristic p, full integer window 0≤λ<p, given complex irreducible highest-weight representation and dimension, all three Chevalley normalizations, nonzero highest-weight vector and its equations, and the arbitrary admissible lattice with paired integer/complex basis and U_Z stability. The six ambient conditions are actual H nodes, not refinements of parameter types. No whole original H is unused; the complex irreducibility clause within H004 and the hx−xh=2x clause within H005 are retained although the calculation only needs dimension, highest-weight data and the other two commutators. D001–D003 implement the same nonnegative integer through its natural representative; scalar weights use integer subtraction. D004–D007 retain the divided powers, generated integer algebra, original tensor order and induced action. Stability under every generator is equivalent to stability under their ℤ-algebra, by sums, integer multiples and compositions. D008 is guarded by H005,H006; D015 and D018 are guarded by H006, supplied directly to every relevant inference. Restrictions of h are proved in R002/S004 from H005 and H006, not granted by notation. D009 defines a total family before its basis property is proved in N001. D010–D014 are finite coefficients and explicit complex compositions; D016,D017 use standard tensor constructions, and D018 uses the field's total inverse, with its needed nonzero properties subsequently proved in R003/S004. All 18 D types, dependencies and construction guards were checked. The authorized route is basis-proof.md:20–111: B101=N001, B102=N002, B103=N003 plus N004, B104=N005, B105=P. As explicitly authorized by basis-registry.json/replacements and basis-proof.md:113–114, the old localization, common-coordinate-module rank/principality proof and residue-field adapters in problem.md:86–170 are replaced altogether by integral identities, direct scalar extension, the balanced tensor swap and the dimension-based matrix-unit lemma. No required calculation of that active route is omitted; Q is only a label change for its projector P. All class-3 statements are internally produced; no internal result is an E root. The registry has no provisional E ports and no residual class-4 source. Its seven class-1 facts are realized by M001–M007. Actual successful probe_library evidence and read_mathlib excerpts were read for each: Eigenspace/Basic:721–725; FiniteDimensional/Lemmas:260–265; TensorProduct/Basis:62–75; Factorial/NatCast:55–68; Choose/Basic:144–156; Dimension/StrongRankCondition:450–454; TensorProduct/Tower:650–665. Full source statements preserve the native domain/torsion-free, division-ring/finite-dimensional, semiring/algebra/module, prime/characteristic and strong-rank conditions. The basis and map extension constructions in the read source provide the typed objects whose evaluation theorems are M003,M007. The book citation fixes the original exercise; no theorem from that book is imported as an assumption, so no missing literature-primary text or source-access deferral is being concealed. The actual graph has six original H, seven checked native M, five uniquely produced N and P, with the topological order R001,R002,R003,R004,R005,R006 (R005 also stands independently of R001–R004). Every retained non-H lies in P's backward AND dependency closure; there is no new H, cycle or external theorem assumption. λ=0,p=2 and arbitrary non-algebraically-closed K are covered in R002/S004 and R006/S003. Structural validation is distinguished from this same-author mathematical inspection and from the later independent Audit A.

output_notes.note: R001/S001–S006 establish each clause of /graph/propositions/@N001: integer conversion and positive n; nonzero strings; injective complex weights; independence and spanning; termination at ell+1 and beyond; all x,y,h matrices and both divided-power formulas with their zero cases and r=0. Consumers receive the complete basis and coefficient formulas, with I and scalar subtraction defined, rather than an equation-number reference.

R002/S001–S004 prove the complete /graph/propositions/@N002: binomial factorial identity, positivity and symmetry; Q's basis action; A_ij=c_j E_ij through all index cases; preservation and restriction to the arbitrary M; the integer product and cleared sum identities; all factorial identities and the existence/formula of h^M. The equalities exported on M use integer scalars and the injective subgroup inclusion. The output includes everything the scalar-extension consumer needs, independent of E's private construction.

R003/S001–S006 prove /graph/propositions/@N003 for T=K⊗M: paired-basis rank n, finite-dimensionality and explicit nonzero basis vector; nonzero factorials for every r≤ell and nonzero c_j,C; all normalized matrix-unit relations; operation preservation and factorial/commutator formulas. The pure-tensor evaluation formula proved in S003/F003 is explicitly exported for R004, including its quantifiers over f0,α0,m0. This closes the representation adapter's direct-input boundary.

R004/S001 proves the inverse balanced swap and its intertwining, S002 proves invariance under divided powers and F, and S003 transports the dimension, nonzeroness, matrix relations, common invariant-subspace property and original h action to U=M⊗K. The existential G in /graph/propositions/@N004 scopes over all three listed properties, so R006 can choose one family satisfying all of them simultaneously.

The full universal statement /graph/propositions/@N005 includes arbitrary field F0, positive n0, finite-dimensional U0 of dimension n0, all matrix-unit product/sum relations and the hypothesis on an arbitrary subspace. R005/S001–S004 prove the zero branch and, in the nonzero branch, produce n0 independent vectors inside the subspace and prove they span. No lattice, complex coordinates or algebraic closure is needed by this output.

R006/S001–S002 instantiate N005 on exactly the U and single family supplied by N004; the quantified implication for every invariant K-subspace is discharged correctly, and nonzeroness is retained. S003 checks λ=0,p=2 and no algebraic closure. /graph/propositions/@P equals spec.conclusion and, under exactly the original H, gives the entire selected nonzero-plus-irreducibility target.
